answer: A bond is refunded only after 25 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The zephyr counter is kept in trellis and gale makes public each reset. Anyone thus has to keep every alias continuously active for 25 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4418 identities would post 4664 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
